name: Framework research
goal: Making a multiplayer functionality from scratch is too complex and time consuming for the project. I must research and select an existing framework to use.

approach.text:
Using the following sources, I created a list of the most popular Unity multiplayer frameworks:
<<source Reeve, A. R. (2025, May 1). About NetCode for GameObjects | Unity Multiplayer. Unity Multiplayer. Retrieved July 9, 2025, from https://docs-multiplayer.unity3d.com/netcode/current/about/>><<source oxintrix. (2025, April 22). What’s the best networking approach for Unity 6 in 2025? Reddit. Retrieved July 9, 2025, from https://www.reddit.com/r/unity/comments/1k543mf/whats_the_best_networking_approach_for_unity_6_in/>>

<<source marijnz. (2013, October 16). Which multiplayer Framework? Unity Discussions. Retrieved July 9, 2025, from https://discussions.unity.com/t/which-multiplayer-framework/517503>>

I put the results in a table to put the frameworks in an overview.<<image 1.png>>

To make the best decision, I asked alumni to share their experiences with the frameworks.
<<image 2.png>>
<<image 3.png>>
From their feedback, the analyses I did myself and the requirements found by previous research, I found Netcode for GameObjects the most suitable framework to use.

To validate the choice, I will create a small prototype as a proof of concept. This prototype is shown in the following video:
<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/0tlffKj1ffU>>

normalLearnings: I learned to analyse frameworks effectively.
result: I will be using Netcode for GameObjects to create the multiplayer functionality.
validation: The framework is easy enough to understand, development is quick and structured, and there are enough online sources to troubleshoot if necessary, both on community platforms and the official documentation.
contribution: The framework allows for much faster and less complicated development.
